dct_description_sm: Over the next  several decades using a watershed perspective, Arctic Network (ARCN) will monitor long term trends in chemical, physical, and biological characteristics of large lake ecosystems and their associated fish populations within Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve. Objectives include: 1) Detect decadal-scale trends in species richness and abundance of macroinvertebrate taxa in lakes; 2) Detect decadal-scale trends in size, distribution, and number of shallow lakes and ponds; 3) detect decadal-scale trends in structure and composition of vegetation in lakes and ponds; 4) detect decadal-scale trends in water quality of lakes and ponds.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: Lake communities and ecosystems: National Park Service Alaska Region Inventory & Monitoring Program
